sn36.7:1.1: This discourse shows how a practitioner first develops the four kinds of mindfulness meditation for gaining immersion, along with practicing “situational awareness” (sometimes called “mindfulness in daily life”), before developing insight into the nature of feelings.
sn36.7:1.2: The “infirmary” (_gilānasālā_) is mentioned only in this discourse and the next, and in [an5.121]().
